import json, random, resource, subprocess, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tmp/dev')
import ref
def limits():
    for kind, pair in ((resource.RLIMIT_AS,(2*1024**3,2*1024**3)),(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(180,181)),
                       (resource.RLIMIT_NOFILE,(256,256)),(resource.RLIMIT_NPROC,(64,64)),
                       (resource.RLIMIT_FSIZE,(64*1024**2,64*1024**2)),(resource.RLIMIT_CORE,(0,0))):
        resource.setrlimit(kind,pair)
rng = random.Random(4242)
N=8192; fib=[]; seen=set()
while len(fib)<N:
    L=rng.choice([rng.randint(0,16),rng.randint(17,64),rng.randint(65,128)])
    a=ref.mask(rng.getrandbits(128),L)
    if (a,L) in seen: continue
    seen.add((a,L)); fib.append((a,L,rng.randint(0,4194302)))
allputs = fib + [rng.choice(fib) for _ in range(131072-N)]
rng.shuffle(allputs)
state={}
for a,l,h in allputs: state[(a,l)]=h
statel=[(a,l,h) for (a,l),h in state.items()]
queries=[rng.choice(fib)[0] for _ in range(100000)]+[rng.getrandbits(128) for _ in range(31072)]
hx=lambda a:'%032x'%a
ops=[['put',hx(a),l,h] for a,l,h in allputs]
ops.append(['query',[hx(x) for x in queries[:65536]]])
ops.append(['save']); ops.append(['load_saved',0]); ops.append(['image_query',[hx(x) for x in queries[:1000]]])
ops.append(['save']); ops.append(['save'])
ops.append(['query',[hx(x) for x in queries[65536:130072]]])
ops += [['load_saved', i%3] for i in range(13)]
raw=json.dumps({'cases':[{'ops':ops},{'ops':ops[:100]}]}).encode()
print('request MiB %.1f'%(len(raw)/1048576.0))
env={"PATH":"/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin","HOME":"/workspace","LANG":"C","LC_ALL":"C","TMPDIR":"/workspace/tmp",
     "PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE":"1","PYTHONUNBUFFERED":"1","PYTHONHASHSEED":"0","OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS":"1",
     "OMP_NUM_THREADS":"1","MKL_NUM_THREADS":"1"}
t0=time.time()
p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'/workspace/run.py'],input=raw,capture_output=True,cwd='/workspace',env=env,preexec_fn=limits)
print('rc',p.returncode,'elapsed %.1fs'%(time.time()-t0),'out MiB %.2f'%(len(p.stdout)/1048576.0),p.stderr.decode()[:200])
r=json.loads(p.stdout.decode())['results']
Q=ref.make_lpm(statel)
print('case0 live ok', r[0]['answers'][:65536]==[Q(x) for x in queries[:65536]])
print('case0 live2 ok', r[0]['answers'][-64536:]==[Q(x) for x in queries[65536:130072]])
print('loads', set(r[0]['loads']), 'snaps', len(r[0]['snapshots']), 'case1 answers', len(r[1]['answers']))
ok,reason,fib0=ref.validate_image(r[0]['snapshots'][0],want_fib=True)
print('snapshot valid',ok,reason,'fib match',sorted(fib0)==sorted(statel))
Q2=ref.make_lpm(fib0)
print('image ok', r[0]['answers'][65536:66536]==[Q2(x) for x in queries[:1000]])
